signers.signers.title: Signers
signers.standing.accepted: Accepted, waiting for the network to show their seat
signers.standing.acceptedNext: They have accepted. Nothing for you to do but wait for the network to show their seat; reload in a minute.
signers.standing.finish: Seated, waiting for you to finish adding them
signers.standing.notSeated: Not seated on the network yet
signers.standing.notSeatedNext: They must open their invitation link and take the seat in their own wallet. Nothing for you to do until they have.
signers.standing.unread: Where each signer stands could not be read just now. Nothing was sent. Reload the page to try again.
signers.namedYou: This signer was saved under the name “You” when the company was made, because no name was given then. It is another signer, not you.
signers.giveKeys.why: You are seated. Give your keys from your wallet, so the company's directory names your seat. Then a signer who holds the company's vaults gives you each vault's secret in their next action from their wallet; until then the vaults do not open for you.
signers.pending.title: Waiting for approvals
signers.pending.unread: The invitations waiting for approvals could not be read just now. Nothing was sent. Reload the page to try again.
signers.pending.scope: Rights over vaults: {scope}. Your account's window names the vaults when you approve.
signers.pending.coinKey: Coin key: {coinKey}. Your account's window shows it in full when you approve.
signers.pending.approvals.unknown: Approvals so far: not known yet.
signers.pending.neededUnknown: How many approvals adding a signer needs could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.
signers.threshold.title: Approvals the company asks for
signers.threshold.now_one: The company asks for {count} approval from its signers.
signers.threshold.now_other: The company asks for {count} approvals from its signers.
signers.threshold.unread: How many approvals the company asks for could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.
signers.threshold.pending.change_one: A change is waiting for approvals. If it goes through, the company will ask for {count} approval.
signers.threshold.pending.change_other: A change is waiting for approvals. If it goes through, the company will ask for {count} approvals.
signers.threshold.pending.invite: The invitation to {name} is waiting. The number of approvals the company will ask for once they take the seat: {threshold}.
signers.remove.threshold.label: Approvals the company asks for afterwards (optional)
signers.remove.threshold.hint: Leave it as it is to keep the number the company asks for now.
signers.remove.why: Your wallet shows whose seat this takes and asks you to confirm there. The removal is carried out once the network counts the approvals it needs.
signers.removal.waiting: Your approval of the removal of {name} was sent. The network takes them off once the other signers' approvals bring it to the number it needs.
signers.removal.counted: Approvals the network counts so far: {approvals} of {needed}.
signers.removal.ready: The removal of {name} has the approvals it needs and is not carried out yet. Reload the page in a minute to see whether the network has taken them off.
signers.removal.retirement: Your approval of the removal of {name} was sent. This wallet asks the network to carry it out once enough signers have signed {name}'s retirement and it is recorded on the network.
signers.removal.carried: {name} is removed. The network has carried the removal out.
signers.removal.unknownState: The wallet did not say where the removal of {name} stands. Reload the page to see where the network has it.
signers.removal.vaultsNotStarted: The change of each vault's secret did not start on this press, and deposits into the vaults wait until it is done. A signer who stays presses Change vault secrets under Vault secrets on this page.
signers.pending.noCoinKey: This invitation cannot be approved, because it carries no coin key for the person's address. Nothing on this page can withdraw it yet. Contact support to have it withdrawn.
signers.pending.approvedNext: Every approval is in. {name} now opens the link and takes the seat. When the network shows the seat, a signer presses Finish adding on this page.
signers.pending.seatTaken: Every approval is in, and {name} has taken the seat. Press Finish adding beside their name under Signers to admit them.
signers.standing.waiting: Has a seat. Request to join not received yet
signers.standing.waitingNext: They took a seat on an invitation, and their request to join has not reached this page. It arrives when they finish on their own device, and Finish adding appears then. Reload to check. If it does not arrive, ask them to open their invitation link again. If the invitation was withdrawn, nothing on this page can add them.
signers.pending.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this invitation was raised, so it can no longer seat anyone. The signer who raised it withdraws it from the Proposals page, then invites again.
signers.pending.seatWaiting: Every approval is in, and {name} has taken the seat on the network; but their request to join has not reached this page. When it arrives, press Finish adding beside their name under Signers. Reload to check.
signers.approvedHere: Your approval was sent from this device. Pressing Approve again would be refused.
signers.working.step: Waiting for your account, step {step} of {steps}.
signers.done.next_one: Adding a signer needs {count} approval in all. The other signers give the rest from their own accounts. Then {name} takes the seat from their own wallet, and a signer presses Finish adding here.
signers.done.next_other: Adding a signer needs {count} approvals in all. The other signers give the rest from their own accounts. Then {name} takes the seat from their own wallet, and a signer presses Finish adding here.
signers.done.nextUnknown: The other signers give the rest of the approvals the company asks for, from their own accounts. Then {name} takes the seat from their own wallet, and a signer presses Finish adding here.
signers.done.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this invitation was raised, so it can no longer seat anyone, and your approval does not change that. The signer who raised it withdraws it from the Proposals page, then invites again.
signers.done.complete: The approvals are complete. {name} now takes the seat from their own wallet, and then a signer presses Finish adding here.
signers.done.keysGiven: Your keys are given to the company.
signers.done.keysGivenNext: A signer who holds the company's vaults now gives you each vault's secret, in their next action from their wallet. Until then the vaults do not open for you. Nothing more is asked of you.
signers.partial: Part of this may already have gone through. Press the same button again to carry on: nothing is counted or added twice.
signers.sent: The wallet stopped, but before it did it handed over transactions that may already have been sent, and they cannot be taken back. The company's records are read again: wait a few minutes, then check them before you try again.
signers.add.title: Add a signer
signers.add.description: Invite someone at their private address. Once they take their seat, you finish adding them here.
signers.why.not-a-company: Your account could not tell which company this is, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.no-saved-keys: Your account does not hold the keys saved for your seat on this device, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.no-seat: Your keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was sent. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
signers.why.seat-not-held: The seat your keys hold is not one the company's account holds on the network yet, so nothing was sent. If you have just been seated, wait a minute and try again.
signers.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was sent. Finish creating the company first.
signers.why.roster-not-opened: Your account could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.not-a-proposal: The page did not name an invitation your account can approve, so nothing was approved. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.not-approved: Your account did not approve it, and shows why in its window. Nothing was sent. Read the reason there, then reload the page and try again.
signers.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this invitation, so nothing was sent. The other signers give the rest of the approvals; once the person takes the seat from their own wallet, press Finish adding beside their name under Signers.
signers.why.carried-out: This invitation already has its approvals and the person has taken the seat, so there is nothing to approve and nothing was sent. Press Finish adding beside their name under Signers to admit them.
signers.why.withdrawn: The invitation was withdrawn while your approval was being sent, so there is nothing more to approve.
signers.why.may-be-sent: The approval stopped after part of it was handed over to be sent.
signers.why.not-a-signer: The page did not name the person waiting to be added, so nobody was added. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.not-the-invited: Your account would not add them: the seat taken is not the one the approved invitation names. Nobody was added. Reloading will not change this: the person has to be removed as a signer and invited again. Removing a signer cannot be done from this page yet; contact support.
signers.why.id-taken: Your account would not add them: the service named them with the id of another signer on this company. Nobody was added for it. Do not give this person access; tell the company's other signers and contact support.
signers.why.chain-unread: Your account could not read the network to check the seat they took, so nobody was added yet. This says nothing against their seat. Press Finish adding again.
signers.why.not-admitted: Nobody was added, and your account shows why in its window. Read the reason there. If it says the seat taken is not the one invited, reloading will not help: the person has to be removed as a signer and invited again, and removing cannot be done from this page yet, so contact support. Otherwise reload the page and try again.
signers.why.filed-not-entered: They are admitted, but the company's records do not name them yet. Press Finish adding again: it names them in the records and files nothing twice.
signers.why.records-key-refused: Your account did not give your keys, and shows why in its window. Nothing was filed. Read the reason there.
signers.why.entry-not-filed: Your account signed your keys, but your entry in the company's directory was not filed yet. Press Give your keys again in a minute: nothing is filed twice.
signers.why.stopped: Your account stopped before this finished.
signers.why.other: Your account refused this for a reason this page does not know. If it stops again, tell the company's other signers.
setup.blocked: This step opens once “{step}” is done.
setup.step.createCompany.name: Create the company
setup.step.createCompany.line: Name your company. You are its first signer. Until you add signers and choose how many must approve, you approve payments on your own.
setup.step.finishCompany.name: Finish creating the company
setup.step.finishCompany.line: Your company is sent to the network and is not finished until the network shows it. Nothing after this step opens until it is.
setup.step.signers.name: Add signers and set approvals
setup.step.signers.line: Invite the people who approve spending, and choose how many of them must approve each payment.
setup.step.vault.name: Create a vault
setup.step.vault.line: A vault holds the money payroll is paid from.
setup.step.people.name: Add people
setup.createCompany.nameHint: This service reads the name once, to set up the company. After that it is kept locked, and only you and the people you add can open it.
setup.createCompany.nameFirst: Enter a name to create the company.
setup.createCompany.how: Your wallet opens on this page to give the key your company's account is held by. The company and its keys are made on this device, and nothing is sent to the network until the next step.
setup.createCompany.started: Your company is made on this device. Your wallet named it {label}.
setup.again.confirm: This sets the unfinished company this browser keeps aside, and you can create a new company after it. It is set aside only if the network shows no account for it and nothing sent for it can still land; its keys stay saved, and it can be finished later if its account does appear.
setup.again.landed: This company's account is already on the network, so it cannot be started again. Finish it.
setup.again.wait: What was sent for this company can still reach the network for about {minutes} minutes, so it was kept. Wait, or finish it; if it has not landed by then you can start it again.
setup.again.unsure: The network could not be read well enough to say that nothing of this company reached it, so it was kept. Try again in a minute, or finish it.
setup.again.working: Looking at the network to see whether this company can be set aside.
setup.again.queued: Another step of the creation is still being sent. This waits for it to finish, then looks at the network.
setup.again.cancelled: Nothing was changed. The unfinished company is still kept.
setup.again.dropped: The unfinished company is set aside. Nothing of it can still reach the network, its keys stay saved, and you can start a new company.
setup.again.nothing: This browser keeps no unfinished company to start again, so there is nothing to set aside. You can start a new company.
setup.createCompany.made: A company is started. Go on to finish it.
setup.finishCompany.press: Your wallet finishes the company in one window: it builds the company's account, has it put on the network and finished, and seals your pay-record key, proving each step itself. Keep that window open until it is done.
setup.finishCompany.interrupted: Finishing the company stopped at step {step} of {steps}. What was already sent stays sent. Continue, and your wallet carries on from what the network shows.
setup.finishCompany.running: Your wallet is on step {step} of {steps}. Keep its window open.
setup.finishCompany.locked: What this device kept of the company is in your saved keys. Open your wallet to carry on.
setup.finishCompany.stage.deploy: The network is putting the account in place.
setup.finishCompany.stage.finish: The network is finishing the account.
setup.finishCompany.stage.key: Your pay-record key is being sealed.
setup.finishCompany.stage.shown: Waiting for the network to show it to your wallet.
setup.finishCompany.phase.proving: Proving the account on this device. This is the slow part.
setup.finishCompany.phase.sending: Sending the account to the network.
setup.finishCompany.phase.waiting: Waiting for the network to show the account.
stageProgress.usualMinute: This usually takes about a minute.
stageProgress.longer: This is taking longer than usual. It is still working. Keep this page open.
stageProgress.noUsual: How long this takes depends on your other signers.
setup.finishCompany.carries: Your wallet runs every step; nothing is sent from this page without your press.
setup.finishCompany.cannot: This company was started and not finished, and it cannot be finished from here. You can create a new company.
setup.finishCompany.nothing: No company is waiting to be finished.
setup.finishCompany.signedOut: You are no longer signed in here, so where the company stands could not be read. Nothing was changed. Sign in again to carry on.
setup.finishCompany.unread: Where the company stands could not be read: the service did not answer within {seconds} seconds, or it refused. Nothing was changed. Try again.
committeeChange.name: Who holds the company
committeeChange.what: Your company's super admins hold the rules of its account and of every vault. Without the signers, they can change any of those rules, and so take money out of any vault. Enough of the super admins must sign each change.
committeeChange.sign: Sign the change in your account
committeeChange.confirm: Your account signs a change that brings your vaults under the super admins who hold your company's account now. Whoever holds a vault can change its rules, and so take money out of it, without the signers. Nothing is sent until enough of the super admins who hold each vault have signed.
committeeChange.noCompany: No company is chosen, so there is no committee to read.
committeeChange.reading: Checking who holds your company's rules.
committeeChange.holds.notOnChain: Your company is not on the network yet, so there is no change to sign.
committeeChange.holds.held: Your super admins hold the company account and every vault. No change is owed.
committeeChange.holds.changeOwed: Your super admins have changed, and some of your vaults are still held by the super admins from before. Until the super admins who hold each one now sign a change to match, anyone who has left can still change that vault's rules. Payments into and out of your vaults go on as usual.
committeeChange.holds.heldByOtherKeys: Your company's account is held by keys that are not your super admins'. Nothing here can change that. Contact support.
committeeChange.holds.unreadable: We could not check who holds your company just now. Nothing was sent. Check again shortly.
committeeChange.holds.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached. Nothing was sent.
committeeChange.done: Your signature is in. The change is sent once enough of the super admins who hold each vault have signed.
records.noCompany: You are not part of a company yet. Create one from the company menu at the top.
records.locked.title: Open your company's records
records.locked.body: Your company's name, people, runs and proposals are locked, and only the keys saved for you open them. Your account opens those keys when you approve. Nothing is signed or paid.
records.noKeysHere.title: This company's records do not open here
records.unreadable: This part could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.
records.unrecognised_one: {count} amount is in a token this app does not know, so it is not shown.
records.unrecognised_other: {count} amounts are in a token this app does not know, so they are not shown.
records.unrecognisedOne: In a token this app does not know
proposals.kind.payRunPrivately: Pay the shielded payments of the {month} run in {token}
proposals.kind.payRunPublicly: Pay the public payments of the {month} run in {token}. Anyone can see who is paid and how much.
proposals.kind.payRunUnknownToken: Pay the {month} run in a token this app does not know
proposals.kind.payRunPrivatelyUnknownTok: Pay the shielded payments of the {month} run in a token this app does not know
proposals.kind.payRunPubliclyUnknownToke: Pay the public payments of the {month} run in a token this app does not know. Anyone can see who is paid and how much.
proposals.kind.setVaultThreshold: Change how many must approve for a vault
proposals.kind.changePolicy: Change a rule for the company's money
proposals.kind.adoptVault: Bring a new vault into the company
proposals.kind.vaultSecret: Set a new vault's first security secret
proposals.kind.payKey: Set the company's key for its payment records
proposals.kind.unreadable: A proposal this device could not read
proposals.status.expired: Closed when its time ran out
payroll.status.paidUnread: Whether it was paid could not be read
createVault.what: A vault is built on this device and sent to the network, held from the start by your company's super admins. It is then added to your company's account and set up. Until it is set up, this app puts no money into it.
createVault.why.noCompany: Create your company first. A vault belongs to a company.
createVault.why.reading: Checking whether a vault can be created…
createVault.why.yoursMissing: Give your vault keys first. A vault is created only once every signer has given theirs.
createVault.why.othersMissing: Not every signer has given their vault keys yet. A vault can be created once they all have, each from their own account.
createVault.why.notOnChain: Your company is still being set up on the network. Check again in a few minutes.
createVault.why.locked: Your keys are not open on this page yet. Name the vault and create it: your wallet checks first that it can be created. Or open your keys with your wallet to check here.
createVault.nameHint: 1 to 64 characters. It is kept in your company's records, sealed so that only the people who sign for the company can read it.
createVault.why.nameFirst: Enter a name to create the vault.
createVault.why.notFinished: Your company is not finished being created. Finish creating it before you create a vault.
createVault.confirm: You approve in your account. The vault is then built on this device, which can take a few minutes, sent to the network, held by your company's super admins, and set up. This service pays the network fee. A vault cannot be removed once it is sent. Keep this page open until it is done.
createVault.stage.checking: Your wallet is filing your vault keys and bringing your company's records up to date…
createVault.stage.building: Your wallet is building the vault, adding it to your company's account and setting its secret. This can take a few minutes…
createVault.done: The vault is created and set up, and your company's super admins hold it.
createVault.held.byOtherKeys: Your company's account is held by other keys than its super admins. The vault is held by whoever holds the account. If you did not expect this, contact support.
createVault.held.changeOwed: A change of your company's super admins is still owed, so some of your company's contracts are still held by the previous ones. Finish the change on the signers page.
createVault.held.unreadable: This page could not read who holds your company's account, so it cannot say whether its super admins hold it. Reload the page to check again.
createVault.held.unreachable: This page could not check who holds your company's account just now: the service could not be reached, or you are no longer signed in. Reload the page, and sign in again if asked.
createVault.said.proposalNotWrittenDown: A step of setting this vault up is on the network, and is not yet written in your company's records. The set-up is not held back by it.
createVault.said.nameNotFiled: The vault was created without its name and description, which could not be filed. It is shown by its number.
createVault.said.nameGivenBefore: This vault already has a name, given before this press, so the one you typed was not filed.
createVault.awaiting.adoption: Your super admins hold the vault, but it cannot take money yet. Adding it to your company needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Each of your other signers approves it from their own device: they open this vault and press Finish setting it up. This app puts no money into it until it has them all.
createVault.awaiting.firstSecret: The vault is added to your company, but it cannot take money yet. Its set-up needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Each of your other signers approves it from their own device: they open this vault and press Finish setting it up, and their device first checks that every signer can open the vault's secret with their own recovery words. This app puts no money into it until it has them all.
createVault.startOwed: Setting up the vault did not finish. It cannot take money yet, and this app puts none into it. Finish setting it up.
createVault.stopped.wallet: Setting up the vault stopped before its secret was approved: your wallet did not show this vault as held by your company on the network. Open your company with your wallet again, then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until it is set up.
createVault.stopped.signers: Setting up the vault stopped before its secret was approved: not every signer is set up for vaults as your signers stand now. Each signer opens your company's vaults on their own device once, then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until then.
createVault.stopped.walletAsk: Setting up the vault stopped before its secret was approved: your wallet was asked to show who holds your company and this vault, and it was declined, closed or did not answer. Finish setting it up and approve it in your wallet when it asks. This app puts no money into the vault until it is set up.
createVault.stopped.directory: Setting up the vault stopped before its secret was approved: your company's directory could not be read, so whose seat each signer holds could not be checked. Reload the page, then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until it is set up.
createVault.stopped.adoptionStale: Setting up this vault cannot finish. A signer was removed or replaced after it was proposed, so the network will never carry it out, and this app neither withdraws it nor proposes it again. This vault holds no money: create a new vault instead.
createVault.stopped.tooFewApprovers: Setting up this vault cannot finish with your signers as they are now: too few of them could approve it. Change your signers or how many must approve, then finish setting it up. This vault holds no money.
createVault.stopped.readersCannotOpen: Setting up this vault stopped because not every signer can open its secret. Ask each signer to open your company's vaults on their own device, then finish setting it up. This vault holds no money.
createVault.stopped.anotherSecret: This vault already holds a secret your company's records do not have, so it will not be set up. It holds no money. Create a new vault and send nothing to this one.
createVault.stopped.readBackOnly: Setting up this vault stopped: its first secret would be raised from a copy read back from your company's records, which nothing on the network vouches for. It holds no money. Create a new vault instead.
createVault.stopped.mismatch: Setting up the vault stopped before its secret was approved: the people its secret would be sealed to are not exactly your signers, each with a key their own wallet signed. Its secret was not approved and no money moved. Reload the page; if it happens again, contact support.
createVault.resume.nameUnread: Its name could not be read. Try again.
createVault.resume.nameAgain: This vault has no name yet. Name it above to carry it on.
createVault.confirmStart: You approve in your account. Setting up the vault then carries on from this device, from where it stopped. Keep this page open until it is done.
vaults.tile.name: Vault {number}
vaults.money.none: This vault holds none of the tokens this app shows.
vaults.privateMoney.cannotRead: What this vault holds privately could not be read: {why}. Open the vault to check again.
vaults.privateMoney.notBelieved: What this vault holds privately is not shown, because its record was not believed. Open the vault to check again.
vaults.standing.held: Set up. Money can go in and out.
vaults.standing.startOwed: Not set up yet. This vault is not yet added to your company with its secret, so this app puts no money into it. Any signer can carry it on from their own device.
vaults.standing.notOnChain: Created, and not yet confirmed by the network
vaults.standing.notFundable: This vault was changed in a way this app cannot check. This app puts no money into it. Send nothing to it from anywhere else, and contact support.
vaults.standing.accountNotHandedOver: Your company's account is not yet held by its super admins. Open Who holds the company to finish.
vaults.standing.accountNotFundable: This app cannot vouch for how your company's account was created or what it runs, so it puts no money into any vault. Contact support.
vaults.standing.heldByOtherKeys: This vault is held by keys that are not your company's super admins. Contact support before you use it.
vaults.standing.unknown: Where this vault stands could not be checked just now. Reload the page to try again.
vault.privateMoney.cannotRead: What this vault holds privately could not be read: {why}. {next}
vault.privateMoney.next.again: Use the refresh button above the table to try again.
vault.privateMoney.next.noKeys: Open your company's records in your wallet first: press Check my last deposit above, which asks your wallet to open them. Then use the refresh button above the table.
vault.privateMoney.next.record: The money stays in the vault and is not lost. Tell the company's other signers and contact support.
vault.privateMoney.nothingYet: This vault holds nothing privately yet.
vault.privateMoney.notBelieved: What this vault holds privately is not shown, because its record was not believed: no seat of your company signed it, or the network does not agree with it. Use the refresh button above the table to read it again.
vault.privateMoney.why.noKeys: your company's keys are not open in this tab
vault.privateMoney.why.walletRefused: your wallet did not answer when asked who holds your company
vault.privateMoney.why.chain: the network could not be reached
vault.privateMoney.why.layout: this vault is not built the way this version of the app reads
vault.privateMoney.why.record: the network shows money in this vault that this device's record does not hold, so this device cannot use it yet
vault.privateMoney.why.other: this device could not finish reading it
vault.privateMoney.unrecognised_one: This vault holds {count} token privately that this app does not know, so its amount is not shown.
vault.privateMoney.unrecognised_other: This vault holds {count} tokens privately that this app does not know, so their amounts are not shown.
vaults.publicMoney.unreadable: What this vault holds publicly could not be read. Open the vault to check again.
vault.publicMoney.unrecognised_one: This vault holds {count} token this app does not know, so its amount is not shown.
vault.publicMoney.unrecognised_other: This vault holds {count} tokens this app does not know, so their amounts are not shown.
people.column.name: Name
people.panel.title: Change
people.locked.invited: They have not accepted yet, so nothing can be changed until they have accepted and been admitted.
people.locked.waitingForCheck: They have accepted and are waiting to be admitted, so nothing can be changed until they are.
people.locked.left: They have left, so nothing can be changed.
people.locked.notPayable: They will not be paid, so nothing can be changed. Why is said above.
people.admit.locked.invited: They have not accepted yet, so there is nothing to admit.
people.admit.locked.left: They have left, so there is nothing to admit.
people.admit.title: Check the fingerprint
people.admit.hint: Five groups of four letters and numbers, as they read it out to you.
people.admit.claim: Their wallet signed a claim of the address you added them by, so there is no fingerprint to check.
people.partial: Part of this may have gone through. The list is read again, so check it before you try again.
people.sent: The wallet stopped, but before it did it handed over transactions that may already have been sent, and they cannot be taken back. The list is read again: wait a few minutes, then check it before you try again.
people.problem.no-fingerprint: Type the fingerprint they read out. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.bad-fingerprint: That is not a fingerprint: it is twenty letters and numbers, in five groups of four. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.no-amount: Type the new pay. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.bad-amount: That is not an amount. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.zero-amount: The pay cannot be nothing. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.too-many-decimals: That has more decimal places than their token has. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.no-asset: Their token is not one this app knows, so their pay cannot be changed here. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.no-date: Choose the date. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.bad-date: That is not a date. Nothing was sent.
people.problem.no-classification: Choose full time or part time. Nothing was sent.
people.why.not-a-company: This company is not open on this device. Nothing was done.
people.why.no-saved-keys: The page did not give the wallet your saved keys. Reload the page and try again. Nothing was done.
people.why.no-seat: Your saved keys on this device hold no seat of this company. Open the company on the device where you took your seat. Nothing was done.
people.why.seat-not-held: The network does not hold your seat of this company yet. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-on-chain: This company is not on the network yet. Nothing was done.
people.why.roster-not-opened: The wallet could not open the company's list of signers. Reload the page and try again. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-believed: This person's record is not one the wallet believes a seat of your company filed. A signer has to file it again from their own device first. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-found: The wallet does not find this person in the company's records. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-as-shown: What the wallet read is not what this page shows, so it did not act. Read again and try once more. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-filed: Nothing was filed for this person to act on. Nothing was done.
people.why.fingerprint-needed: This person has to be admitted on a fingerprint they read out. Nothing was done.
people.why.fingerprint-not-needed: This person is admitted on their wallet's signed claim, so a fingerprint is not checked. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-admitted: The wallet did not admit this person. What they handed over, their invitation or another record failed one of its checks, and the reason is in the wallet's window. Nothing was done.
people.why.not-changed: The wallet did not change this person. Nothing was done.
people.why.terms-raised: A pay run for vendors has already been raised, and a vendor's terms carry no date, so no vendor's terms can be changed from here: changing them would change what a raised month pays. Nothing was done.
people.why.date-raised: A pay run has already been raised for a month on or after the date asked, or on or after the date it would replace or clear, and a raised month is never paid differently. Choose a date after the newest raised month. Nothing was done.
people.why.filed-not-entered: The record is filed, but the service has not accepted its entry in the company's records, so no device believes it yet. Until it does, nobody can be admitted or changed. Do not try again: ask whoever runs the service to look at it.
people.why.filed-not-entered-nor-anchore: The record is filed, but the service has not accepted its entry in the company's records, so no device believes it yet. The anchor was not made either. Until the service accepts it, nobody can be admitted or changed. Do not try again: ask whoever runs the service to look at it.
people.why.asked-wrongly: The wallet could not read what was asked. Nothing was done.
people.why.stopped: The wallet stopped before it finished.
people.why.other: The wallet stopped, and gave no reason this page knows.
invitations.kind.vendor: To be paid as a vendor
records.notOpened.says: Not opened yet. Your wallet has not opened this company on this visit.
records.notOpened.some: Some records are not opened yet, so the list below may be incomplete. Open with your wallet to see all of it.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Your wallet files the invitation and gives you a link to send.
invite.kind.label: Who are you inviting
invite.kind.superAdmin.why: Super admins are invited by the company's super admins, never from a seat, so this cannot be sent from here.
invite.name: Name
invite.way.label: How they join
invite.address.person.hint: Their Midnight address on this network. A private address keeps what they are paid off the public record. If you give a public address, anyone can look up each payment to it, with the amount.
invite.address.signer.hint: A signer is invited at their private address. Ask them for it; the link you get is then theirs to open.
invite.role.label: Role
invite.role.admin.says: May file every kind of company record.
invite.role.initiator.says: May file pay runs, transfers and proposals.
invite.role.viewer.says: May file none of the company's records.
invite.role.later: Limited and accountant cannot be given from here, because an invitation carries only the four roles above. Choose Admin, Approver, Initiator or Viewer.
invite.scope.label: Which vaults
invite.scope.chosen.why: This page cannot choose vaults yet, so a signer is invited for every vault. If that is more than you want to give, wait before inviting them.
invite.approvals.account_one: Adding a signer needs {count} approval, the number the account asks for.
invite.approvals.account_other: Adding a signer needs {count} approvals, the number the account asks for.
invite.approvals.raised_one: Adding a signer needs {count} approval. The account asks for fewer, but a vault you have adopted asks for {count}, and the higher number applies.
invite.approvals.raised_other: Adding a signer needs {count} approvals. The account asks for fewer, but a vault you have adopted asks for {count}, and the higher number applies.
invite.approvals.raisedUnnamed_one: Adding a signer needs {count} approval, more than the account asks for.
invite.approvals.raisedUnnamed_other: Adding a signer needs {count} approvals, more than the account asks for.
invite.threshold.label: Approvals needed once they have a seat
invite.threshold.hint: By default the company keeps the number of approvals it asks for now. Choose another to change it once they take the seat.
invite.threshold.unread: How many signers the company has could not be read just now, so the number cannot be changed from here. Reload the page to try again.
invite.walletNote: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is sent.
invite.working.step: Waiting for your wallet, step {step} of {steps}.
invite.done.title: Invitation filed
invite.done.link.anyone: Give this link to {name}. Whoever opens it can take up the invitation, so send it to them only.
invite.done.link.holder: Give this link to {name}. Only the holder of the address you gave can take up the invitation with it, so send it to them only.
invite.done.link.privateAddress: Give this link to {name}. Their wallet must hold the address you gave, but nothing checks that for a private address. Before you admit them, check the fingerprint they read out with them in person or on a call you place.
invite.done.linkOnce: This link is shown only now. Copy it before you close this.
invite.done.signer: {name} is not a signer yet. The proposal to seat them waits for approvals, and shows on the {page} page until it has them.
invite.done.signerComplete: {name} is not a signer yet. Your invitation was the approval the company needs, so no other signer has to approve. {name} opens the link and takes the seat, and then a signer presses Finish adding on the {page} page.
invite.done.threshold_one: Once {name} takes the seat, the company will ask for {count} approval.
invite.done.threshold_other: Once {name} takes the seat, the company will ask for {count} approvals.
invite.link.refused: This browser would not copy the link. Select it in the field above and copy it by hand.
invite.stopped.title: The invitation did not finish
invite.sent: The wallet stopped, but before it did it handed over transactions that may already have been sent, and they cannot be taken back. The company's records are read again: wait a few minutes, then check them before you press Invite again.
invite.stopped.closing: Stay on this screen to carry on with this invitation. If you close or leave it, the invitation is forgotten here, and pressing Invite again raises a new one beside this one.
invite.stopped.closingSigner: If you close or leave this, the page forgets the link. The proposal may already be raised, and then the same address cannot be invited again until it is withdrawn, which this page cannot do yet. Stay here and press again.
invite.problem.end-before-start: The end date is before the start date.
invite.problem.bad-email: That is not an email address.
invite.problem.bad-amount: That is not an amount. Type digits with a point for decimals, for example 12.5.
invite.problem.zero-amount: An amount must be above nothing.
invite.problem.too-many-decimals: That has more decimal places than this currency has. Remove the extra digits.
invite.problem.bad-address: That is not a Midnight address on this network.
invite.problem.not-private-address: A signer is invited at their private address, and this is a public one.
invite.problem.role-later: That role cannot be given from here. Choose Admin, Approver, Initiator or Viewer.
invite.problem.super-admin: A super admin cannot be invited from here.
invite.problem.bad-threshold: The approvals needed must be a whole number of at least one. Choose Keep the number now to leave it as it is.
invite.problem.threshold-too-high_one: Once this seat is taken the company has {count} signer, so it cannot need more approvals than that. Choose a smaller number, or seat more signers first.
invite.problem.threshold-too-high_other: Once this seat is taken the company has {count} signers, so it cannot need more approvals than that. Choose a smaller number, or seat more signers first.
invite.why.not-a-company: This company could not be read, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
invite.why.no-saved-keys: Your wallet was not given your saved keys, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
invite.why.no-seat: Your saved keys hold no seat on this company, so nothing was sent. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
invite.why.seat-not-held: Your seat is not one the company's account holds on the network yet, so nothing was sent. If you were just seated, wait a minute and try again.
invite.why.not-on-chain: This company has no account on the network yet, so nothing was sent. Finish creating the company first.
invite.why.roster-not-opened: Your wallet could not open the company's list of signers with your seat, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
invite.why.not-a-token: The invitation's link could not be made, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
invite.why.no-name: Give the person's name. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.not-an-asset: The currency chosen is not one your wallet knows, so nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-pay: The pay must be above nothing, so nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-classification: Choose full time or part time. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-start: Give a start date. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-terms: Choose how the vendor is paid, one-off or monthly. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-role: Choose a role for the signer. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.signer-by-address: A signer is invited at their private address. Ask them for it. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.super-admin: Super admins are invited by the company's super admins, never from a seat, so nothing was sent.
invite.why.not-a-kind: Choose who you are inviting. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.no-opening: Your saved keys do not record how your seat was made, so the person invited could not check it. Take your seat again in this device's wallet. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.own-address: That address is one your wallet holds, and one wallet holds one seat. Ask the person for their own address. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.wider-scope: The invitation offers more vaults than your seat covers, so nothing was sent. Ask a signer whose seat covers every vault.
invite.why.not-a-threshold: The number of approvals needed once the seat is taken must be a whole number of at least one. Choose Keep the number now to leave it as it is. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.threshold-refused: The number of approvals needed once the seat is taken cannot be met: it is more than the company would have signers, or it would leave a vault with too few people able to approve. Choose a smaller number, or choose Keep the number now. Nothing was sent.
invite.why.not-made: The invitation was not made, and nothing was handed over. Try again.
invite.why.not-filed: The company did not file the invitation, and nothing was raised. Try again.
invite.why.raised-not-filed: The proposal to seat this address was raised, but the invitation was not filed. Press again to file it.
invite.why.may-be-sent: The invitation stopped part way, after part of it was handed over. Do not start a new one: press again to carry on with this same invitation.
invite.why.filed-not-entered: The invitation was filed, but its record is not entered in the company's records yet, so other devices do not believe it yet. Do not start a new invitation: press again to carry on with this same one.
invite.why.offer-not-read: Your wallet could not read whether this invitation is already filed, so nothing was signed or sent. The invitation is kept: press again in a minute to carry on with this same one.
invite.why.stopped: Your wallet stopped before the invitation was finished. Press again to carry on with this same invitation.
invite.why.other: Your wallet refused this invitation for a reason this page does not know. Part of it may have been handed over, so do not start a new one: press again to carry on with this same invitation. If it stops again, tell the company's signers.
proposals.someNotRead_one: {count} proposal could not be read on this device. It is listed by its number alone and is not counted as waiting.
proposals.someNotRead_other: {count} proposals could not be read on this device. They are listed by their numbers alone and are not counted as waiting.
proposal.act.notPaid: Your wallet finished without paying it. Reload the page to see where this payment stands.
proposal.act.why.seat: Your account could not act for this company on this device, so nothing was sent. Open the company on the device where you took your seat, or reload the page and try again.
proposal.act.why.not-a-proposal: The page did not name a proposal your account can act on, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
proposal.act.why.not-approved: Your account did not approve it, and shows why in its window. Nothing was sent. Read the reason there, then reload the page and try again.
proposal.act.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this proposal, so nothing was sent.
proposal.act.why.carried-out: This proposal already has its approvals and has been carried out, so there is nothing to approve and nothing was sent.
proposal.act.why.withdrawn: The proposal was withdrawn, so there is nothing more to act on.
proposal.act.why.may-be-sent: Your account stopped after part of this was handed over to be sent.
proposal.act.why.not-as-shown: Your account opened this proposal and it is not what this page showed, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Do not approve it: reload the page, and if it still differs, tell the company's other signers.
proposal.act.why.closed: The network no longer holds this proposal open: it was carried out, withdrawn or closed already. Nothing was sent. Reload the page to see where it stands.
proposal.act.why.not-raised: The network does not hold this proposal raised yet, so there is nothing to act on and nothing was sent. Reload the page once the network shows it.
proposal.act.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this proposal was raised, so the network will not carry it out. Nothing was sent. Raise it again.
proposal.act.why.other: Your account refused this for a reason this page does not know, and shows it in its window. Nothing was sent. Read the reason there, and if it happens again, tell the company's other signers.
changeThreshold.title: Change approvals needed
changeThreshold.description: Choose how many of the signers must approve each payment.
changeThreshold.label: Approvals the company asks for
changeThreshold.hint_one: The company has {count} signer, so that is the most it can ask for.
changeThreshold.hint_other: The company has {count} signers, so that is the most it can ask for.
changeThreshold.unread: How many approvals the company asks for, or how many signers it has, could not be read just now, so the number cannot be changed from here. Reload the page to try again.
changeThreshold.because_one: Changing this needs {count} approval from the signers, because that is the number the company asks for now.
changeThreshold.because_other: Changing this needs {count} approvals from the signers, because that is the number the company asks for now.
changeThreshold.checks: Your wallet checks every vault before it asks you for anything, and does not ask for a number that would leave a vault with fewer signers able to approve its runs than it needs.
changeThreshold.walletNote: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is sent.
changeThreshold.done.carried_one: Done. The company now asks for {count} approval from its signers.
changeThreshold.done.carried_other: Done. The company now asks for {count} approvals from its signers.
changeThreshold.done.waiting: Raised. The other signers approve it from {page}. Until it has the approvals it needs, the company keeps asking for the number it asks for now.
changeThreshold.refused: Your wallet checked every vault and did not ask for this number: it is more than the signers the company has, or it would leave a vault with fewer signers able to approve its runs than it needs. Choose a smaller number, or give another signer the right to approve runs on that vault first. Nothing was sent.
changeThreshold.problem.not-whole: The approvals needed must be a whole number of at least one. Choose Keep the number now to leave it as it is.
changeThreshold.problem.too-high_one: The company has {count} signer, so it cannot need more approvals than that, or nothing could ever be approved. Choose a smaller number, or seat more signers first.
changeThreshold.problem.too-high_other: The company has {count} signers, so it cannot need more approvals than that, or nothing could ever be approved. Choose a smaller number, or seat more signers first.
changeThreshold.problem.same: The company already asks for that many approvals, so there is nothing to change. Choose another number.
changeThreshold.problem.unread: How many approvals the company asks for, or how many signers it has, could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.
changeThreshold.vault.label: Approvals this vault asks for
changeThreshold.vault.unread: How many approvals this vault asks for, or how many signers the company has, could not be read just now, so the number cannot be changed from here. Reload the page to try again.
changeThreshold.vault.because_one: This changes only {vault}, which asks for {count} approval from the signers now. Your wallet checks the rest, including how many approvals the change itself needs, before it asks you for anything.
changeThreshold.vault.because_other: This changes only {vault}, which asks for {count} approvals from the signers now. Your wallet checks the rest, including how many approvals the change itself needs, before it asks you for anything.
changeThreshold.vault.done.carried_one: Done. {vault} now asks for {count} approval from its signers.
changeThreshold.vault.done.carried_other: Done. {vault} now asks for {count} approvals from its signers.
changeThreshold.vault.done.waiting: Raised. The other signers approve it from {page}. Until it has the approvals it needs, {vault} keeps asking for the number it asks for now.
changeThreshold.vault.problem.same: {vault} already asks for that many approvals, so there is nothing to change. Choose another number.
payRun.title: Pay {month}
payRun.walletNote: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is paid.
payRun.done.paid_one: Paid. {count} person was paid, and nobody is still owed.
payRun.done.paid_other: Paid. {count} people were paid, and nobody is still owed.
payRun.done.partly: Partly paid: {paid} paid, {owed} still owed. Press Pay again to pay only the people still owed: nobody is paid twice.
payRun.done.partly.unseen: Partly paid: {paid} paid, {owed} still owed, and {unseen} may still be landing. Wait a few minutes and open this vault again before you press Pay. It pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
payRun.done.already: The network already shows everyone on this payment paid, so nothing was paid now.
payRun.done.awaiting: This run does not have the approvals it needs yet, so nothing was paid. Press Pay once the other signers have approved it.
payRun.done.unknown: Your wallet finished, but did not say how many people were paid. Open this vault again in a few minutes to see.
payRun.why.seat: Your account could not act for this company on this device, so nothing was paid. Open the company on the device where you took your seat, or reload the page and try again.
payRun.why.not-a-proposal: The page did not name a run your account can pay, so nothing was paid. Reload the page and try again.
payRun.why.not-as-shown: The run your account opened is not the one this page showed, so nothing was paid. Do not pay it: reload the page, and if it still differs, tell the company's other signers.
payRun.why.not-raised: The network does not hold this run's proposal yet, so nothing was paid. Reload the page once the network shows it.
payRun.why.closed: The network no longer holds this run's proposal open, so nothing was paid. Reload the page to see where it stands.
payRun.why.withdrawn: This run's proposal was withdrawn, so nothing was paid.
payRun.why.not-open-yet: This run's payment window has not opened yet, so nothing was paid. Press Pay again once it has opened.
payRun.why.window-closed: This run's payment window has closed, so nothing was paid. Raise a retry for the people still owed.
payRun.why.not-payable: The vault cannot pay this run as it stands, so nothing was charged or paid. Your wallet's window says why.
payRun.why.pay-stopped: Paying stopped part way. Press Pay again: it pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
payRun.why.pay-stopped-unseen: Paying stopped part way, and a payment may still be landing. Do not press Pay yet: wait a few minutes and open this vault again first. Paying then pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
payRun.why.payment-not-as-built: Your wallet could not build a payment the way it needs to, so paying stopped. Some people may already have been paid: open this vault again in a few minutes to see, then press Pay again. It pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
payRun.why.not-paid: The run was not paid and nothing was sent. Your wallet's window says why.
payRun.why.may-be-sent: Your wallet stopped after part of this was handed over to be sent. Wait a few minutes, then press Pay again: it pays only the people still owed, and nobody twice.
payRun.why.other: Your wallet stopped for a reason this page does not know, and shows it in its window. Read the reason there, and if it happens again, tell the company's other signers.
publicFacts.title: What this payment makes public
publicFacts.vault: The network shows that your company's account called {vault} to pay this run.
publicFacts.count_one: It shows one payment leaving the vault for each payment made, so anyone can count how many payments the vault has made. This run pays {count} person.
publicFacts.count_other: It shows one payment leaving the vault for each payment made, so anyone can count how many payments the vault has made. This run pays {count} people.
publicFacts.counter: The vault's public count of payments goes up by one for each payment sent from the vault, and a payment can cover several people.
publicFacts.private.hidden: The addresses paid and the amounts are not shown on the network.
publicFacts.private.inference: Anyone who has seen this vault's earlier payments can still work out who was paid, from what was spent and what came back as change.
publicFacts.private.band: If this vault has a spending policy, the number of approvals this run needed shows which band of the policy its total falls in.
publicFacts.public.says: A public payment puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read. Every person this run pays is put on it, with what they are paid.
publicFacts.public.names: Names are not put on the record. They are shown here only so you know who is who.
proposals.withdraw.why.not-as-shown: The proposal on the network is not the one this page showed, so nothing was withdrawn. Reload the page and try again.
proposals.withdraw.why.one-off-held: The network already holds this payment, so it cannot be withdrawn. Leave it unapproved: it cannot be paid once its time ends.
proposals.withdraw.why.not-withdrawn: It was not withdrawn, and your account shows why in its window. Nothing was sent. Read the reason there, then reload the page and try again.
oneOff.title: Pay someone
oneOff.name: Name for this payee (optional)
oneOff.vendor.address: Paid at the address in their vendor entry: {address}
oneOff.walletNote: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is proposed. When your approval is all the vault needs, the wallet also pays it.
oneOff.done.raised: The payment was proposed. It is not paid yet: once the vault has the approvals it needs, a signer carries it out.
oneOff.problem.no-asset: Choose the currency to pay in.
oneOff.problem.bad-amount: That is not an amount. Type digits with a point for decimals, for example 12.5.
oneOff.problem.zero-amount: An amount of nothing is not a payment. Type an amount above nothing.
oneOff.problem.too-many-decimals: That has more decimal places than this currency has. Remove the extra digits.
oneOff.problem.bad-address: That is not an address this app can pay on this network. Check it with the person you are paying.
oneOff.problem.no-reason: Give the payment a reason, so it can be recognised later.
oneOff.problem.reason-too-long: The reason can be at most {count} characters. Shorten it.
oneOff.problem.name-too-long: The name can be at most {count} characters. Shorten it.
oneOff.pay.title: Approve a payment
oneOff.pay.walletNote: Your wallet opens to confirm this before anything is approved. When your approval is the last the vault needs, the wallet also pays it.
oneOff.paying.title: Pay an approved payment
oneOff.paying.walletNote: This payment has the approvals it needs and the network shows it not yet paid. Your wallet opens to confirm it, then pays it.
oneOff.problem.no-vault: Choose the vault to pay from.
publicFacts.payment.vault: The network shows that your company's account called {vault} to make this payment.
publicFacts.payment.count: It shows one payment leaving the vault, so anyone can count how many payments the vault has made.
publicFacts.payment.band: If this vault has a spending policy, the number of approvals this payment needed shows which band of the policy its amount falls in.
publicFacts.payment.public.says: A public payment puts the address, the amount and the currency on a record anyone can read.
raiseRun.title: New run
raiseRun.noVault: This company has no vault to pay from yet.
raiseRun.walletNote: Your wallet opens to draw the run and show you its people and total. Nothing is raised until you confirm there.
raiseRun.done: The run was raised. It waits for the approvals it needs.
raiseRun.done.counted: The run was raised. It has {approvals} of the {needed} approvals it needs.
raiseRun.why.seat: Your account could not act for this company on this device, so nothing was raised.
raiseRun.why.not-a-run: Your wallet could not draw a run from what this page named, so nothing was raised.
raiseRun.why.window: The payment window this page gave was not one your wallet could use, so nothing was raised. Try again.
raiseRun.why.not-as-shown: The run your wallet drew is not the one it showed you, so nothing was raised.
raiseRun.why.not-raised: The run was not raised, and nothing was sent to the network.
raiseRun.why.may-be-sent: Your wallet handed the run on, and did not confirm it went. Do not raise it again: open the Proposals page and look for it.
raiseRun.why.other: Your wallet stopped for a reason this page does not know, so nothing was raised.
raiseRun.window.missing: Choose when payments open and when they close. Both are needed before the run can be drawn.
raiseRun.window.past: Payments must open later than now. Choose a later time for them to open.
raiseRun.window.order: Payments must close after they open. Choose a later time for them to close.
signers.rotation.rotated: The company's key was changed, and the signers who stay hold the new one.
signers.rotation.filed-not-anchored: The change of the company's key was filed and is not recorded on the network yet. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet goes on from there.
signers.rotation.rotated-elsewhere: Another signer already changed the company's key.
signers.rotation.not-needed: The company's key did not need changing.
signers.rotation.waits: The company's key is not changed yet: another step has to finish first. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet changes it.
signers.rotation.not-this-seat: Your seat does not change the company's key here. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet changes it.
signers.rotation.not-rotated: The company's key was not changed on this press. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet tries again.
signers.rotation.not-tried: The company's key was not tried on this press. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet changes it.
signers.vaults.title: Vault secrets
signers.vaults.description: Press Change vault secrets after a signer has left. Each vault whose secret the signer who left can still open is given a new secret. A vault that owes nothing is left as it is.
signers.vaults.promise: After a signer leaves, payments go on as before until a vault's new secret is set, and the signer who left can still read them. Deposits made from this app wait until the new secret is set and filed. From the moment it is set until every signer who stays has a sealed copy of it on the network, the vault takes no deposits and makes no payments. A signer who left can still read what they could read before the change.
signers.vaults.rotated_one: {count} vault is on its new secret.
signers.vaults.rotated_other: {count} vaults are on their new secret.
signers.vaults.awaiting_one: {count} vault's secret change is waiting for approvals from other signers. Once it has them, the next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet finishes it.
signers.vaults.awaiting_other: {count} vaults' secret changes are waiting for approvals from other signers. Once they have them, the next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet finishes them.
signers.vaults.owed_one: {count} vault is owed a secret change. Press Change vault secrets to make it.
signers.vaults.owed_other: {count} vaults are owed a secret change. Press Change vault secrets to make them.
signers.vaults.waiting_one: {count} vault waits for the company's key to be changed first. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet changes it, and then this can go on.
signers.vaults.waiting_other: {count} vaults wait for the company's key to be changed first. The next action a signer who stays takes in their wallet changes it, and then this can go on.
signers.vaults.notChanged_one: {count} vault could not be changed on this press. Press Change vault secrets again: it goes on from where it stopped.
signers.vaults.notChanged_other: {count} vaults could not be changed on this press. Press Change vault secrets again: it goes on from where it stopped.
signers.vaults.nothingOwed: No vault is owed a secret change.
signers.vaults.unread: Your wallet did not report how each vault stands. Reload the page and press Change vault secrets again: a change that is still open is not raised again.
signers.vaults.partial: Some vaults still owe their change. What was done stays done: pressing again goes on from here and does not raise a change that is still open.
signers.why.not-a-removal: This page did not pass on a seat to remove, or the number of approvals was not a whole number, so nothing was sent. Check the number and try again.
signers.why.refused: Your account would not remove them, and shows why in its window. Nothing was sent. Read the reason there.
signers.why.not-raised: The removal was not raised, and your account shows why in its window. Read the reason there, then reload the page and try again.
signers.why.not-carried: The removal has its approvals and was not carried out. Press Remove again, with the same number of approvals, to carry it out.
signers.why.not-as-shown: The removal the network holds is not the removal of this signer at this number of approvals, so nothing was approved and nothing was sent. Reload the page.
signers.why.not-read: Your account has not read whose seat this takes, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.no-such-seat: The company's list of signers, as your account opened it, holds no such seat, so it cannot say whom this takes off. Nothing was sent. Reload the page, and if it happens again, tell the company's other signers.
signers.why.unread-seat-first: The network shows a seat taken on an invitation that your account cannot tie to the company's list of signers. Your wallet's window names it. Remove that seat first, then this one. Nothing more was sent.
signers.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this removal was raised, so the network will never carry it out. Nothing was sent. Withdraw it from the Proposals page, then press Remove again.
signers.why.removal.withdrawn: The removal was withdrawn, so there is nothing to approve or carry out.
signers.why.removal.carried-out: The network has already carried this removal out, so there is nothing left to approve, and nothing was sent.
signers.why.removal.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this removal, so nothing was approved again and nothing was sent.
signers.why.removal.may-be-sent: The removal stopped after part of it was handed over to be sent. Press Remove again: what the network already holds is not sent twice.
signers.why.no-person: Your account was not told who is signed in, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
signers.why.not-a-vault: Your account was given a vault it cannot read as one, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
